title: (a*) kind of blue: drum hits visualized as a dot-matrix form on black
note: Audio-visual inspo for Lydia. "Demo 02 of visualizing music on blue" (posted Thu 2026-10-29): an electronic drum kit drives a white dot-matrix shape on black, with labels for Crash, Tom 1, Tom 2, Ride, Hi-hat, Snare, Kick and Floor tom lighting up as each is hit, and the live drumming shown underneath. Site: http://a-kind-of.blue
